pages.text: $(thing)Create Deep Seas$() adds submarines. A sub is a Create-style contraption that moves as one solid, physical vessel, built on the same Sable and Aeronautics tech as $(l:flight/airships)airships$(/l). It dives by changing its own weight.

A submarine floats until its $(item)Ballast Tanks$() are filled with sea water. A $(item)Ballast Vent$() is the sea valve and must touch the water. Pipe vent, pump and tanks together: pumping in makes the ship heavier and it sinks, pumping out lets it rise.$(br2)Each tank lifts roughly one block of ship mass, so heavy hulls need more tanks.

pages.title: Ballast Tank
pages.text: Holds the water that weighs the ship down. Read its capacity with Engineer's Goggles.

pages.title: Ballast Vent
pages.text: The sea valve. At least one face must touch the sea. Every face takes a pipe.

The $(item)Onboard Computer$() can dive for you. Click its screen to set a target depth and speed, and it drives the pumps to hold that depth. $(item)Pump Controllers$() on the same ship are found automatically; pipe one between vent and tanks. More controllers or faster rotation mean quicker dives.

pages.title: Onboard Computer
pages.text: Autopilot for depth. With a Sonar on board it can also follow the sea floor and keep the keel clear.

pages.title: Sonar
pages.text: Maps the floor, rocks, ships and mines around you on the Computer's screen.

Pumps and thrusters run on Create $(l:create_basics/rotation)rotation$(/l) and $(l:create_basics/fluids)fluids$(/l), so a sub is a Create machine through and through. Press $(bold)W$() over any Deep Seas block for its Ponder.

pages.title: Submarine Propeller
pages.text: Strong in water, useless in air. Four in a 2x2 square facing one way merge into one big propeller.

pages.title: Water Thruster
pages.text: Uses water and rotation for thrust. More pressure and speed push you faster.

Hull strength, oxygen and airlocks are covered in $(l:ocean/hulls_and_pressure)Hulls and Pressure$(/l). Surface ships and sails are in $(l:ocean/sailing)Sailing$(/l). Where to dive: $(l:ocean/underwater_places)Underwater Places$(/l). Deep Seas also holds an unfinished Create Abyss dimension, but it only switches on in development builds, so it is not in this pack.
